entry.description_cn: 黑金女魔法师掉落的秘文。
entry.story_cn:
备忘：
打开机关门的暗号是——向上高昂的<style="stress">头颅</style>、向前伸出的<style="stress">右手</style>、向下挥砍的<style="stress">利刃</style>

801291.name: Lost Glyph
801291.description: A secret glyph dropped by a female Adamant Syndicate Mage.
801291.story:
Note:
The code word to open the trap door is—The <style="stress">figure</style> held upward, the <style="stress">right hand</style> stretched forward, and the <style="stress">sword</style> swung downward.

801291.name: 落とされた秘文書
801291.description: ブラックゴールドの女メイジが落とした秘文書。
801291.story:
メモ：
仕掛け扉を開ける暗号は……上を向く<style="stress">頭</style>、前へ伸ばす<style="stress">右手</style>、振り下ろされる<style="stress">刃</style>

801291.name: 떨어진 비밀 문서
801291.story:
메모: 
암호는 위로 향하는 <style="stress">고개</style>, 앞으로 뻗은 <style="stress">오른손</style>, 아래로 휘두르는 <style="stress">예리한 칼날</style>이다.
